root.label: Senders and receivers
root.note: C++26 std::execution (P2300 and follow-ups): lazy, composable asynchronous work with structured lifetimes.

children.label: Core contract
children.note: The rules in [exec.async.ops] that every sender, receiver and algorithm obeys.

children.label: Lazy senders
children.note: A sender only describes work; nothing runs until connect and start.

children.label: Three channels
children.note: Complete exactly once: set_value with any arguments, set_error with one, set_stopped with none.

children.label: Operation state lifetime
children.note: Destroying it before completion is undefined behaviour; library op states cannot be copied or moved.

children.label: Completion signatures
children.note: Computed at compile time by a static consteval member; errors are constexpr exceptions (P3557).

children.label: Algorithms
children.note: Factories start chains, adaptors transform them, and all adaptors are pipeable.

children.label: just and friends
children.note: just, just_error and just_stopped complete immediately on one channel.

children.label: then vs let_value
children.note: then sends the callable's result; let_value runs the sender the callable returns.

children.label: when_all
children.note: Concatenates child values; on error or stop it requests stop on the other children.

children.label: Reshaping
children.note: into_variant, stopped_as_optional, stopped_as_error, upon_error and the bulk family.

children.label: Consumers
children.note: Ways to actually connect and start a sender.

children.label: sync_wait
children.note: Blocks, returns optional<tuple<...>>, empty when stopped; needs exactly one value signature.

children.label: Errors become exceptions
children.note: exception_ptr is rethrown, error_code becomes system_error, other errors are thrown as is.

children.label: co_await and task
children.note: Senders are awaitable; std::execution::task<T> (P3552) is a lazy coroutine that is a sender.

children.label: Schedulers
children.note: Handles to execution resources; schedule(sch) completes on that resource.

children.label: starts_on
children.note: Starts the work on a scheduler; the continuation stays wherever the work completed.

children.label: continues_on
children.note: Moves the continuation onto a scheduler after the predecessor completes.

children.label: on
children.note: Goes to a scheduler for the work, then transfers back to where it was started.

children.label: parallel_scheduler
children.note: From get_parallel_scheduler() (P2079): parallel forward progress, replaceable backend.

children.label: Cancellation and scopes
children.note: Cooperative stopping and structured ownership of background work.

children.label: Stop tokens
children.note: Read from the receiver's environment; when_all supplies its own inplace_stop_token.

children.label: counting_scope
children.note: spawn and spawn_future associate work with a scope; join() waits for all of it (P3149).

children.label: Removed: ensure_started
children.note: P3187 removed ensure_started and start_detached; split is not in C++26 either.

children.label: Availability
children.note: Status of implementations in late 2026.

children.label: No GCC or Clang
children.note: libstdc++ 16 and libc++ 21 do not define __cpp_lib_senders.

children.label: stdexec and Beman
children.note: NVIDIA stdexec and the Beman project implement the draft outside namespace std.
